title: Notifications
summary: The bell shows what happens in your organizations (invitations, role changes, removals, policy changes) and, in the app, finished answers, agent questions, plan limits and new versions. The site has the same bell, and reading a notification on one marks it read on the other.
usage: In the app, the bell is to the right of the logo; in Ctrl+K, choose Notifications. On the site, it's in the top bar once you sign in. Click a notification to go to its organization; accept or decline invitations right in the list. You can mark all as read or clear the read ones. Answers, questions and limits only show in the app, on the computer where they happened.
